title: Coins auto-convert; coin and ammo slots (Core model + save, with interim slots UI)
player_outcome: Picking up coins merges them upward automatically (100 copper → 1 silver …) into four dedicated coin slots. Arrows and bullets go into four ammo slots that are used first, top to bottom. Shops and the death penalty count coins wherever they are.
design: Verified: Inventory.Add merges into stacks and never converts (Inventory.cs:34-58); coins are consolidated only by Wallet.TrySpend. PlayerInventory has only Backpack, Armor and Accessories. FindAmmo scans Backpack 0..49.
PlayerInventory: Coins = new Inventory(4), Ammo = new Inventory(4).

Pickup(stack): coins go into Coins and are then normalised by the new Coins.Normalize(Inventory coins, overflow → Backpack), which re-gives the total in the largest denominations. Ammo items (AmmoClass != null and not a weapon) merge into existing ammo-slot stacks, else an empty ammo slot, else the backpack.
Coins.Total(PlayerInventory) sums Coins + Backpack (+ banks from P3-35).

Wallet.TrySpend/Give get PlayerInventory overloads (paying from Coins first, then the backpack; change into Coins). Update the callers: GameWorld.Death.cs, TownCommerce (Buy/Sell/Reforge), TownServices, TownSystem (arrival coin check), InventoryScreen and TownDialog coin labels.
ItemUseSystem.FindAmmo returns (Inventory, slot): Ammo 0..3 first, then Backpack.
PlayerSave: Coins and Ammo slot lists (added fields). On load, move any coin stacks from the backpack into coin slots and Normalize.
StandardProbes: inv.<item> counts Backpack + Coins + Ammo; add coins.total.
Interim UI: two 4-slot columns (Coins, Ammo) beside the backpack in InventoryScreen using ItemSlotView and slot filters (coin tag / AmmoClass). P2 restyles.

CoinAmmoSlotTests: a bow uses ammo slot 0 before a backpack stack; save round-trip keeps coin/ammo slots

risks: InventoryScreen is P2's; the columns are interim. Announce the Core API (PlayerInventory.Coins/Ammo) to P2.
Hidden coins if the UI lags; the interim columns are mandatory in this WP.
